component.name: EmojiTyper
component.summary: Direct emoji picker and typing utility for Linux

description.p: EmojiTyper is a fast, lightweight emoji selector and direct typing tool for Linux. It allows you to search and insert Unicode emojis directly into any focused window across both X11 and Wayland (KDE Plasma, GNOME, Sway, and other compositors).

ul.li: Instant search by keyword, name, and category
Recent emojis memory for quick access
Direct keyboard typing injection into target applications
System tray integration for quick access and background daemon support
Support for both X11 and Wayland environments

description.p: Initial release with full Unicode 16.0 support, Wayland and X11 hotkey injection, search, and categorization.
